_doc: FE-P7 (2026-05-26) Lighthouse CI gate. Category-score assertions are Lighthouse's normalized 0-1 quality scores (industry-standard pass thresholds), NOT fabricated per-app millisecond budgets. The accessibility category (with the axe-core e2e from S2-EXT-1) is the automated WCAG AA gate. Bundle size is gated separately by check-bundle-budget.mjs against the measured bundle-budget.json SSOT. Rationale: docs/architecture/frontend/performance-budget.md.
